Write ten sentences with words from the lesson about nails. Look through the word cloud and practise making sentences using vocabulary from the lesson.
Learn the 7 new Black Friday words in Flashcards below
Pronunciation: practise "article" /ˈɑːtɪkl/ and "chosen" /ˈtʃəʊzn/. Listen, repeat, and record yourself

flashcards.example: I'm trying to cut back on online shopping this month.
She splurged on a new coat in the Black Friday sale.
Prices go up and down because of supply and demand.
Big retailers start their sales a week before Black Friday.
E-commerce has grown very fast in the last few years.
We splashed out on a new TV this year.
I picked up a real bargain: winter boots for half price.
I get a manicure every three weeks.
Gel polish lasts much longer than normal nail polish.
She used a nail file to shape her nails.
The manicurist gently pushed back my cuticles.
Can I see the colour chart, please?
She got long nail extensions for the party.
I prefer natural nails. They're healthier.
Gel polish dries under a UV lamp.
Use a buffer to make your nails smooth and shiny.
File the edge of the nail gently.
Stiletto nails are long and very pointed.
Squoval nails are square with soft, rounded corners.
Oval nails make your fingers look longer.
Coffin nails are long with a flat, square tip.
Short round nails are easy to look after.
Mountain peak nails have a sharp tip, like the top of a mountain.
Square nails have straight sides and a flat edge.
Almond nails are oval with a slightly pointed tip.

feedback.text:
✏️ Your text:
Hi I want to talk about my last manicure 💅 appointment 📅. I was already choosing the Colors they were so beautiful 🤩. She has started by asking me if I want to make nail extensions,I sais no cause I had long natural nails. Then she has toked a nail file cause I had nail that were longer than others .after she has ✂️ my cuticles , then she has puted some nail polish . After that she has puted my nails Ander a UV LAMP . The she has takes a buffer and buffed my nails to make them shiny. And tada 🎉 my nails are ready

✅ Corrected version:
Hi! I want to talk about my last manicure 💅 appointment 📅. I had already chosen the colours, and they were so beautiful 🤩. She started by asking me if I wanted nail extensions. I said no, because I had long natural nails. Then she took a nail file, because I had a nail that was longer than the others. After that, she cut ✂️ my cuticles, and then she put on some nail polish. Next, she put my nails under a UV lamp. Then she took a buffer and buffed my nails to make them shiny. And ta-da 🎉, my nails were ready!

📝 Main points:
1. Past simple for a finished story (not present perfect): has started → started, has toked → took, has puted → put, has takes → took, has ✂️ → cut. Irregular verbs to remember: take – took, put – put, cut – cut, say – said.
2. Spelling: sais → said, Ander → under, The → Then, Colors → colours (no capital letter).
3. Reported question: "she asked me if I wanted…" (want → wanted). We say "get / have nail extensions", not "make".
4. Punctuation: a capital letter after a full stop (.after → After), a space after a comma, no space before a full stop. In writing, use "because", not "cause".
5. A nail → "a nail that was longer than the others".

Well done! 💅 You used lots of words from our nails lesson: manicure, nail extensions, natural nails, nail file, cuticles, nail polish, UV lamp, buffer, buff. Your story is clear and in the right order (then, after that).
feedback.next: Practise past simple irregular verbs (took, put, cut, said) and use the past simple when you tell a story about a finished event.
